# dsh-ui-personalization
A personalization plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) client: it replaces the account row at the b
ottom of the sidebar with your own avatar, nickname and account balance, and can additionally hide t
he brand mark at the top of the sidebar. dsh does not provide any of this itself; the plugin mounts
on slots dsh reserves, as a client-side cordis bundle.
Built against dsh `0.2.1-rc.5`; not tested on other versions.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Refresh the page after installing; if it does not take effect, restart the profile once. `dsh plugin
` passes straight through to pnpm, so the target can also be an absolute path to a local directory:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
This plugin is distributed from GitHub only; there is no npm release. The "Add plugin" dialog in the
settings panel works too — paste the full address above. Entering just `dsh-ui-personalization` fai
ls with "not in the npm registry" — that failure is deliberate: the old name `dsh-personalization` o
n npm belongs to a plugin by another author, and installing by name would install the wrong thing.
An agent inside dsh can install it directly as well: have it run `plugin_manager install_bundle <abs
olute path to the package directory>`.
## Usage
1. The avatar row at the bottom of the sidebar shows your avatar and nickname, with that account's b

alance at the right end; clicking it opens the settings panel.
2. **Settings → Personalization**: a
page in the settings panel's left-hand navigation, listed after "Agent presets". The page is split i

nto two cards by function, each starting with its own switch:
- **Identity row**: Custom identity (s
witch) → Avatar (click the avatar to pick an image; on hover or keyboard focus a pencil icon appears
on the avatar and a cross in its top-right corner; click the cross to restore the default) → Nickna

me
- **Interface elements**: Hide top brand mark (switch)
The avatar is scaled locally to a 128px square and stored in localStorage; the nickname applies imme
diately. When the sidebar is collapsed into an icon rail, the nickname and balance are not shown (th
at row keeps only the avatar).
## Slots it takes over
| Where | Slot | Notes |
| Bottom of the sidebar | `settings.launcher` (single) | Overrides the built-in account row with `pr

iority: -1`; turning "Custom identity" off unregisters it and the original returns unchanged |
| Top
-of-sidebar brand | `sidebar.brand.mark`, `sidebar.brand.name` (single) | While "Hide top brand mark

" is on they mount on top and render nothing; turning it off hands them back |
| Settings panel navi
gation | `settings.section` (list, id `ui-personalization`, order `25`) | One navigation entry per r
egistration; `label` is a thunk that follows the language |
All three mount through `ctx.slots.inject`: they appear when the slot declaration appears and are to
rn down automatically when it disappears. Registrations controlled by a switch are mounted or unregi
stered as the state changes.
**The height of the brand row** is hard-coded by the shell (60px, and not through a token), so blank
ing the two slots above it leaves a gap. The plugin injects one extra rule for this, attached to the
document only while the switch is on:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
This is the only place where the plugin reaches outside its own components. It matches on a fragment
of the shell's CSS-modules local name and refuses rows containing a button — on Windows the collaps
e button sits in that row, and the guard leaves it alone there. If the shell renames the local class
, the rule stops applying on its own, and the result falls back to "content blanked but an empty row
ps applying on its own, and the result falls back to "content blanked but an empty row left behind".
**The settings panel cannot be opened at a given page**: the shell exposes no "open section X" inter
face, so clicking the avatar can only open the settings panel, and which page it lands on is decided
by the shell's own selection state.
## Balance
The number at the right end of that sidebar row comes from the account Remote, along the same path a
s the official account page:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- **Client version**: the `x-client-version` header is read from the page's boot manifest, `window._
_DSH_BOOT__.release.version` — the shell inlines that same release into its own bundles at build tim
e, so a dsh upgrade no longer needs a plugin change. A deployment whose manifest carries no release

shows no balance instead of requesting with a stale version.
- **What it counts**: top-up balance +
grant balance, summed when the currency is the same; it follows the official account page's rules fo

r two decimals and for amounts under one cent (`<¥0.01`).
[该节后续省略]
## Known limitations
1. **There is no "Sign out" entry in the sidebar unless custom identity is off.** The built-in accou
nt row also carries a dropdown menu (Settings / Feedback / Sign out). `settings.launcher` is a singl
e-occupant slot, so taking over the row takes over the whole menu; the official menu is an internal
component of the account plugin with no public export, so this plugin cannot call it. To sign out, t
urn "Custom identity" off on this page and the original account row and menu come back. The official
account settings page does not offer sign-out either (checked against `0.2.1-rc.5`); the rest of th

e settings panel is unaffected.
2. **The brand row is collapsed by a rule matching a class-name frag
ment**, see above. It goes quietly stale when the shell changes structure (leaving blank space, with

no error).
3. **The navigation icon is the same as "General settings".** The shell maps icons by pa
ge id in a fixed table, unknown ids fall back to the default gear, and the registration itself has n

o icon field.
4. **The pencil on the avatar appears only on hover or keyboard focus.** Touch screens
have no hover, so clicking the avatar still picks an image but without that hint; the cross in the
top-right corner stays visible on `hover:none` devices, so it no longer has to be guessed by positio
p-right corner stays visible on `hover:none` devices, so it no longer has to be guessed by position.
